defects.title: No marketplace guard on `/listing/:id` detail entry
defects.reproduction_path: Set session active_marketplace_space=shared_space; open /listing/<independent_places_id> (direct, shared, history, or SEO).
defects.expected: Block, redirect to matching marketplace, or refuse to render opposite marketplace listing while session is SL (and vice versa).
defects.actual: Listing loads via getById; UI space derived from listing (_listingSpace); opposite marketplace content shown; session not switched.
defects.marketplace_impact: D1 navigation bypass — SL seeker can view full IP listing detail (and vice versa) including layout, apply scoring, preference explanations.

defects.title: Listing detail treated as global id-keyed resource
defects.reproduction_path: Swap only the listing id in `/listing/:id` while keeping session space.
defects.expected: URL or resolve path carries marketplace dimension, or resolve filters by tower vs session.
defects.actual: Path has id only; marketplace query params ignored; getById has no tower filter.
defects.marketplace_impact: Trivial URL manipulation surfaces the other marketplace.

defects.title: Internal deep-link handler lacks session-vs-listing compare
defects.reproduction_path: Sole listing deep-link handler: GoRoute path=/listing/:id builds ListingDetailScreen(listingId) with no marketplace compare. redirect handles auth/role aliases only. getById is id-only. Home in-app push passes extra map (already tower-filtered feed). pubspec includes app_links but no AppLinks / uriLinkStream usage in lib/.
defects.expected: GoRouter redirect or ListingDetailScreen gate compares marketplaceContextNotifier.activeSpace to listing tower.
defects.actual: No compare; builder only passes listingId.
defects.marketplace_impact: All future channels (email/push/saved) that target `/listing/:id` inherit the bleed until a guard is added.
